title: ARTEX Explained: An AI Team That Pentests on Its Own
description: What ARTEX is, what makes it different from a scanner or a single chatbot, and how its team of AI agents plans, works, remembers and finishes a security test with little human help.
audience: Anyone curious how an autonomous multi-agent AI system works, no code reading needed.

chapters.title: How ARTEX Fits Together
chapters.summary: Tour the agent team, the work it produces, its shared memory and its guard rails, then rebuild the map from memory.

chapters.title: You Are the Planner
chapters.summary: Step into the team lead's shoes: ten wake-ups, ten decisions about what the agent team should do next.

chapters.title: The Stalled Task
chapters.summary: A lab task stopped making progress overnight. Use the team's own records to work out which part of the agent loop was waiting, and why.

chapters.title: ARTEX Archipelago
chapters.summary: One island per big idea, hands-on activities, then a final exam over the whole system.
